title: Anthropic CEO calls for global AI slowdown to prevent internet ‘swarm’ threat
summary: After years of rapid development in artificial intelligence, one of the most prominent voices in AI says the industry needs to hit the brakes.

title: Sam Altman backs Anthropic over slowing down AI development; vows to follow Amodei's proposal; Musk follows suit
summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and billionaire Elon Musk backed Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei’s call to slow AI development and said OpenAI would adopt a proposed safeguard, as Anthropic researchers warned of risks from increasingly powerful AI systems.

title: Anthropic C.E.O. Dario Amodei Calls for A.I. Slowdown
summary: In an essay, the head of Anthropic laid out the rapidly advancing capabilities of artificial intelligence and said there needed to be greater safety controls across the industry.
author: Mike Isaac
